 (Ramprasad Gupta Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
Dated : 04-04-2022

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. D.K. Melani, learned counsel for the applicant.
Mr. D.K. Paroha, learned Government Advocate for the State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The revision seems to arguable.
It is admitted for hearing.
Let record of the Courts below be requisitioned.
Considered I.A.No.5332/2022 which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

Applicant stands convicted vide impugned judgment dated 28.02.2022 in CRA No.29/2021 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, Special Judge (Electricity Act) Jabalpur, arising out of the judgment and findings dated 18.02.2021 in Criminal Case No.2901493/2010 passed by the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Jabalpur convicting the applicant for the offence punishable under Section 7(1) r/w Section 16 (1)(ka)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo RI for 6 months with fine of Rs.5000/- and default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Special Judge (Electricity Act) Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
The applicant is in custody since 23.03.2022.
Fine amount has already been deposited by the applicant.
Final disposal of this revision would take considerable time.
Therefore, sentence of the applicant be suspended and he be granted bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the application.

Looking to the nature of offence and sentence awarded against the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case,
the application for suspension of sentence is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/-(Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, remaining jail sentence imposed upon Ramprasad Gupta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 April, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158678617/
1 applicant- Ramprasad Gupta shall remain suspended during the pendency of this case and he shall be released on bail.

sentences.text: The applicant shall appear before the trial Court on 05.08.2022 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed in this regard.
List for final hearing in due course.
